To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Common Criteria methodology can be applied to the development of sensor systems and that the development process of such systems can be supported by computer tools.
the computer-aided development of sensors and their systems can be supported by design patterns and knowledge management tools.
the development of intelligent sensor systems according to the Common criteria methodology can be supported by the software tools, design pattern and knowledge engineering.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a computer-aided sensor development methodology based on the Common Criteria methodology.
the development of a methodology and a tool for computer-aided sensor and sensor system security development.
the development of a new generation of sensors with IT security properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented methodology and its tool support is a significant step toward the computer-aided development of intelligent sensors with a view to their IT security assurance.
the proposed approach is a suitable and effective method of the sensors system development with respect to IT security.
the proposed approach is a feasible and promising way to improve the development of IT products and systems, including intelligent sensors and sensor systems, in the context of IT security assurance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach can be used for the development of IT security for sensors, and that the proposed approach is a step towards a computer-aided development of sensor systems.
the computer-aided development of sensors and sensors systems can be supported by the Common Criteria methodology.
the computer-aided sensor development is a feasible approach to achieve IT security assurance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a patterns-based and software-supported methodology can be used in sensor development, which brings cost-, time-, and quality-related advantages.
the security assurance of sensor systems can be achieved in an efficient way using a computer-aided development process based on design patterns.
the security assurance of sensors and sensors systems can be achieved by using the Common Criteria methodology.
